policy: Frozen English bytes remain untouched. Deterministic defects confirmed by the shared audit or by same-agent comparison with immediately controlling formulas are repaired in Marathi bodies, carry adjacent stable keyed notes, and are verified by projecting only documented deltas back to the frozen structure. Shared findings and Marathi-lane findings retain distinct IDs.

audit.consultation_stage: Exact frozen source and each immediately controlling formula, table, definition or proof scope were read; every authoritative finding OLSIZ-001 through OLSIZ-010 is applied. The later identifier OLSIZ-011 is a retracted false positive and remains unapplied.
